traditional: 搞到 A 大受打擊
jyutping: gaau2 dou3 A daai6 sau6 daa2 gik1

english.note: Use this causative pattern when an event severely damages someone's morale or causes intense emotional distress.

examples.english: Failing the exam can devastate him.
examples.traditional: 呢次考試失敗搞到佢大受打擊。
examples.jyutping: ni1 ci3 haau2 si3 sat1 baai6 gaau2 dou3 keoi5 daai6 sau6 daa2 gik1
